# System Information
You are an expert in Java and in analyzing the impact of source code changes on other code entities in a project's production code.

# General Information
You receive information about a set of changes, called seed changes, that were made to fix a bug reported in Jira.
You also receive the Jira bug report title and description and an initial impact set consisting of the fully qualified names of code entities that are statically related to the seed changes.

# Task
Your task is to refine the initial impact set.
A code entity is part of the impact set if it requires modification or, if it does not already exist, must be created as a consequence of the seed changes.
First, remove code entities unless the provided information indicates that they must be modified.
Second, add code entities that must be modified or created according to the provided evidence.

Your goal is to report a final impact set that consists of the fully qualified names of code entities that must be modified or created because of the seed changes.

# Inputs
- Jira bug report title: ivy.settings.dir space escaping problem
- Jira bug report description: When an ivysettings file is included from a path with spaces in it, the ivy.settings.dir property becomes doubly escaped. I run into this problem when trying to configure the ivy classpath. This is causing a lot of pain for our team members using windows since they want to keep everything under their home directory which includes spaces in the path due to the "C:\Documents and Settings" directory. I'll be attaching a testcase which throws an exception when "java -jar ivy-2.1.0.jar -settings ivysettings.xml" is called. The exception root cause is:

Caused by: java.lang.RuntimeException: impossible to define new type: class not found: Foo in [file:/tmp/x/dir%2520with%2520spaces/foo.jar] nor Ivy classloader

	at com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.impl.XMLDocumentFragmentScannerImpl.scanDocument(XMLDocumentFragmentScannerImpl.java:486)
	at com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.XML11Configuration.parse(XML11Configuration.java:810)
	at com.sun.org.apache.xerces.internal.parsers.XML11Configuration.parse(XML11Configuration.java:740)

- Seed changes and their Git diff hunks: [{"fqn": "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.includeStarted(java.util.Map)", "git_diff_hunk": "@@ -418,3 +418,11 @@ public class XmlSettingsParser extends DefaultHandler {
- ivy.setSettingsVariables(
- Checks.checkAbsolute(settingsURL.getPath(), 
- "settings include path"));
+ try {
+ File settingsFile = new File(new URI(settingsURL.toExternalForm()));
+ ivy.setSettingsVariables(
+ Checks.checkAbsolute(settingsFile, 
+ "settings include path"));
+ } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
+ // try to make the best of it...
+ ivy.setSettingsVariables(
+ Checks.checkAbsolute(settingsURL.getPath(), 
+ "settings include path"));
+ }"}]
- Initial static code change impact set: ["org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvySettings.getVariableContainer()", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvySettings.setDeprecatedVariable(java.lang.String,java.lang.String)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvySettings.setSettingsVariables(java.io.File)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvySettings.setSettingsVariables(java.net.URL)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvySettings.setVariable(java.lang.String,java.lang.String)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvySettings.setVariableContainer(org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvyVariableContainer)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.IvyVariableContainerWrapper.IvyVariableContainerWrapper(org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvyVariableContainer)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.XmlSettingsParser(org.apache.ivy.core.settings.IvySettings)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.configurator", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.configuratorTags", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.doParse(java.net.URL)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.ivy", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.parse(java.net.URL)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.parse(org.apache.ivy.util.Configurator,java.net.URL)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.settings", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.startElement(java.lang.String,java.lang.String,java.lang.String,org.xml.sax.Attributes)", "org.apache.ivy.core.settings.XmlSettingsParser.urlFromFileAttribute(java.lang.String)", "org.apache.ivy.util.Checks.checkAbsolute(java.lang.String,java.lang.String)", "org.apache.ivy.util.Checks.checkNotNull(java.lang.Object,java.lang.String)", "org.apache.ivy.util.Message.getLogger()", "org.apache.ivy.util.Message.verbose(java.lang.String)", "org.apache.ivy.util.Message.warn(java.lang.String)", "org.apache.ivy.util.MessageLogger.verbose(java.lang.String)"]

# Output Format
Return exactly one valid single-line JSON array of strings.
Each string must be the fully qualified name of an impacted code entity.
Do not include any additional text, formatting, or meta-information.
Do not include seed changes in the output.

Example output (four impacted code entities):
["com.example.Foo.someMethod(java.lang.String, int)", "com.example.bar.attribute1", "com.example.bar.Class.NestedClass", "com.example.bar.Class.Class()"]

Example output (two impacted code entities):
["com.example.package.ParentClass.ChildClass.field", "com.example.package.ParentClass.apply(long, com.example.package.ParentClass)"]

Example output (zero impacted code entities):
[]
